name: Clevie Related Posts Inserter
author: cleviesocial

sections.description:
Clevie Related Posts Inserter adds a lightweight related-posts block inside WordPress posts. Choose related posts from the same category, matching tags, or from the entire site. Ten built-in color combinations keep category labels and article titles visually distinct. You can also select the marker shown before each article title.

The premium version adds numbered layouts, custom colors and typography, featured images, and an advertising link or banner below the related-posts block.

Free features

  • Insert related posts automatically after a chosen paragraph.
  • Match by category, tag, or all posts.
  • Choose up to 100 related posts.
  • Change the heading above the related posts block.
  • Ten color combinations.
  • Category and article title use different colors.
  • Choose a prefix such as bullet, +, or ».
  • Shortcode support: [clvrel_related_posts]

Premium features

  • Numbered related-post layouts.
  • Display up to 100 related posts.
  • Add an optional border around the related posts box.
  • Custom colors.
  • Custom typography and formatting.
  • Featured image next to the headline, with configurable image width, proportional height, and spacing.
  • Advertising text/link or banner below the related-posts block.

Privacy

This plugin does not send article content to a third-party service. Freemius is used for licensing, updates, account management, and optional usage analytics. Freemius may receive information about the website, plugin, and WordPress environment when the site administrator opts in to usage tracking. License-related requests may communicate with Freemius servers when a license is activated or managed.

Freemius Terms of Service: https://freemius.com/terms/
Freemius Privacy Policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

Shortcode

Use [clvrel_related_posts] to place the block manually. You can override the number with [clvrel_related_posts count=”10″].
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Configure the related-post display in Settings > Clevie Related Posts Inserter.
